title: Interparfums raises 2026 forecast and expects strong growth in 2027
summary: Interparfums SA, which manages global fragrance licenses for brands including Jimmy Choo, Montblanc, and Lacoste, as well as a portfolio of its own brands such as Rochas, Annick Goutal, and Solferino, announced on Thursday, November 19, that it had slightly raised its 2026 revenue target to EUR 880 million, up from EUR 870 million previously. title: Boots taps into 'K-Wellness' with a new line of beauty-from-within products

title: Scientists warn of growing health threats of endocrine-disrupting chemicals
summary: Chemicals found almost everywhere in modern life pose a "global and growing threat" to human health and the environment, a landmark report based on over a decade of research has warned. The report on "endocrine-disrupting chemicals" (EDCs) released by the United Nations Environment Programme and World Health Organization "conservatively" estimates the health and environmental costs of EDC exposure at over US$1 trillion annually. title: IFF opens a bioprospecting lab for fragrance and beauty in Brazil
summary: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) has inaugurated its first Forest Lab at Legado das Águas, Brazil's largest private Atlantic Forest reserve. The bioprospecting laboratory is dedicated to scientific research and innovation in perfumery and beauty. The lab is the next step in the bioprospecting partnership IFF announced in August 2025 with Reservas Votorantim (rV), the green economy division of Brazilian investment firm Votorantim SA, which manages the reserve.
